rule: A case is `train` when the first byte of sha256("<seed>:<case directory name>") is below 154 (about 60%), else `test`. The rule depends on the case's name alone, so adding a case never moves another.
seed_note: Drawn at random from 32 bits. The seed that split the first 14 cases left 4 of the 15 current cases in test, so seeds were redrawn (1 draws in all, the earlier ones included) until train held 9 or 10 of the 15; the redraw looked at case counts only, before any case had been run. Case v09-record-backends-disagree was added afterwards and assigned by the rule without a redraw. Case c10 was renamed for per-lane landing and keeps its side.
